keywords: Revision – Stay order – Trade union action – Strike/walkout – Writs of Certiorari and Mandamus – Interim injunction restraining union action – Amenability to judicial review – Requirement of public legal duty – Trade union as private association rather than public body/state entity – Public impact does not make union a public body – Freedom to form and join trade unions – Statutory recognition of strikes – Doubt whether mandamus can compel union members to work – Interim order partly stayed – High Court directed to proceed with main case. H.C.J. Madawala J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 14(1)(d); Trade Unions Ordinance – sections 2 and 18. The judgment notes that the ICCPR Act appeared in the caption but that the application was not based on it.
